Now I will teach you Fruit. It is soft like squashed berry, sweet like honey, round like stone. It grows on big green hand-like branch. It has skin like thin hide, inside is wet and many small hard things. You can eat it, not like rock. this is Fruit.

Discover seed, tree, sun.
